entries.en: What the heck...
...Geez, mister, you just won't stop[n]bugging me, huh?
I wish you'd just leave me alone...
I know what this is... My mom was talking[n]about it the other day.

That's "domestic violence."

Um, are things okay at home?
Oh! That's it! I guess you do know more[n]stuff since you're older than me.

I'm smart.
I'm good at PE.
Shut up.
Whoaaa, really!? You don't look smart.
Nope, I don't believe you. Don't get mad[n]at me just 'cause you're not smart...
My dad says that people who like to say[n]they're smart... they're actually stuuupid.
I guess you can say you're smart even if[n]your grades are just a tiny bit better than[n]other people's...
Ooh, you must be good at fighting then!
Your brain's a muscle, too, ya know!
Do you actually need a brain for PE,[n]though?
Naaaaw, you're fibbing! You should just[n]tell the truth and admit you're stupid.
Whoaaa, I totally knew it! I knew you[n]were a big old stupidhead!
Aww, that's what my mom always says[n]when I ask where babies come from...
Awww, I know you're stupid, but it's okay.[n]You could at least tell the truth...
How come you're yelling at me? I-I used[n]my inside voice...
Hey! You're trying to scare me! But I[n]know you're just stupid!
Whoa! You're really angry, aren't you,[n]mister? Do you have... what was it...[n]"emotional issues"?

Are you gonna do some "mean business"[n]now? No, wait! Do you "mean business"[n]now?
I can't believe you're fighting a kid like[n]me... Pick on someone your own size!
You're a big bully! Don't you think that's[n]"immature"?
Now that you mention it...
No, I don't think so.
I'm not mature anyway.
Okay, if you're really sorry, then I forgive[n]you!
Well, now you know, so don't do it again![n]You should know better than a little kid[n]like me!
Hey! You need to have more "kamen[n]sense."
Oh, yeah... Um, can you tell me what[n]"immature" means?
Awww, c'mon, stop being so mean to me...
Oh! If my dad was here, he'd say that you[n]don't "half ask" anything!
Mister, you're not very nice. You don't[n]have a girlfriend, huh? It's 'cause girls[n]don't like you.
Wow! You don't "give a jitt"!
I bet a teen like you knows how to at least[n]"act" like an adult when you've gotta!

Uh, well maybe you should be...
Oooh, see? You're being "immature"[n]right now!
Whoaaa, did you get mad at me 'cause[n]I was right? That is sooo immature!
I guess you're the type who doesn't know[n]how to be "raisinable"...
I'm not scared of you just 'cause you[n]have a cool gun! Nooo, you look like[n]a stupidhead!
Oh, yeeeah! I wanted to ask you, mister,[n]'cause maybe you know why...
What's it like to be all kissy face with[n]somebody?
It's incredible...
I shouldn't tell you.
Ask your parents.
Whoa! I bet it, like... makes you all tingly!
Tell me more! Tell me more!
That's... not very specific. Ooh, I know![n]I bet you've never kissy faced anyone,[n]mister!
That doesn't tell me anything!
No, wait a minute... You don't have a[n]girlfriend, right? So you don't know...

Uh-oh... You don't know either, huh?

Oh yeah, isn't it almost "supper"?

Hamburgers.
Humans.
Shut up.

Ugggh, that's so BORING!

Storks deliver them.
Ask your parents.

Hey, you're just trying to ignore me![n]Come on, tell me!

Ain't people your age suppose'ta be out[n]on dates and stuff instead?
Right after this, kid.
Such a rude little boy...

I don't remember.

Soy sauce.
Pickled ginger.
Nothing.

I didn't know that was a thing!
So many people choose that one!
